info.title: FatturaFacile ERP API
info.summary: Multi-tenant ERP API for invoicing, purchasing, inventory, banking, accounting and operations.
info.description:
REST API of the FatturaFacile ERP.

Every request except login and the incoming webhooks must carry a bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`) and the organization it works on (`X-Tenant-Id: <uuid>`). Errors follow RFC 9457 (`application/problem+json`).

get.summary:
Legacy listing of the ledger. It reads the journal entries of the General Ledger module (the one ledger of the
application), so it shows the same entries and figures as `/api/v1/general-ledger/journals`, in the legacy row

Legacy posting of a ledger entry, kept with the same request contract but delegated to the posting service of
the General Ledger module: the entry lands in `journal_entries`, in the fiscal period of its date (refused when
that period is missing, closed or locked), with an exact balance check and the libro giornale number

RegimeFiscale.description: RegimeFiscaleType of the FatturaPA schema v1.2.3 (the schema has no RF03).
RegimeFiscale.title: RegimeFiscale

RejectJournalEntryRequest.description: The reason of a rejected journal, kept for the audit trail.
RejectJournalEntryRequest.title: RejectJournalEntryRequest

RejectSalesReturnRequest.description: Refusal of a return request, with the reason given to the customer.
RejectSalesReturnRequest.title: RejectSalesReturnRequest

RejectionRequest.description: A rejection must say why, so the author knows what to correct.
RejectionRequest.title: RejectionRequest

ReleasePickWaveRequest.description: Releasing a picking wave: the warehouse, the sales orders it serves and the staging bin the picks go to.
ReleasePickWaveRequest.title: ReleasePickWaveRequest

RenewContractRequest.description: Validates the input of the renew contract operation (authorization is decided by module.access).
RenewContractRequest.title: RenewContractRequest

ReorderRuleRequest.description:
A min/max reorder rule of an item in a warehouse. The levels must be consistent: minimum <= reorder point <= maximum.
Every value is the company's: nothing is defaulted except the lead time, which keeps its column default.
ReorderRuleRequest.title: ReorderRuleRequest

ReportingClass.description: Class of an account for the cash flow statement and the ratios.
ReportingClass.title: ReportingClass

RescheduleRequest.description: Validation of new planned dates of a production order.
RescheduleRequest.title: RescheduleRequest

ReserveSalesOrderRequest.description: Reserving stock for a sales order: the warehouse to reserve in, and optionally when the reservations lapse.
ReserveSalesOrderRequest.title: ReserveSalesOrderRequest

ResolveNonConformanceRequest.description: Validation of the closing disposition of a non-conformance.
ResolveNonConformanceRequest.title: ResolveNonConformanceRequest

RestoreUploadRequest.description: Upload of an external backup archive (ZIP) to restore into the current tenant.
RestoreUploadRequest.title: RestoreUploadRequest

RetentionAction.description: Allowed values of retention action in the Documents module.
RetentionAction.title: RetentionAction

RetireComponentRequest.description: Validation of the retirement of a component.
RetireComponentRequest.title: RetireComponentRequest

ReviseBomRequest.description: Validation of a new revision copied from an existing one, with optional component changes.
ReviseBomRequest.title: ReviseBomRequest

ReviseQuoteRequest.description: What changes in a quote revision; every omitted field is taken from the revised quote (its lines included).
ReviseQuoteRequest.title: ReviseQuoteRequest

enum: Simulated fiscal printer: nothing was sent to the Agenzia delle Entrate.

RunBillingPlansRequest.description: The billing plan run: every pending item due on or before a date.
RunBillingPlansRequest.title: RunBillingPlansRequest

RunDeferredInvoicingRequest.description: The deferred billing run: every dispatched delivery note up to a date, optionally of one customer.
RunDeferredInvoicingRequest.title: RunDeferredInvoicingRequest

RunDepreciationRequest.description: Validation of a depreciation run or simulation.
RunDepreciationRequest.title: RunDepreciationRequest

RunMrpRequest.description: Validation of an MRP run: horizon of at most two years, optional items.
RunMrpRequest.title: RunMrpRequest

SalesOrderWarehouseRequest.description: The warehouse an order is checked against or reserved in (the primary warehouse of the company when omitted).
SalesOrderWarehouseRequest.title: SalesOrderWarehouseRequest

SaveAgentToolRequest.description: Creates or changes a canned response, a macro or a saved view; the route name tells which.
SaveAgentToolRequest.title: SaveAgentToolRequest

SaveBidRequest.description: Validates a bid: customer and site of the company, title, language, currency and discount.
SaveBidRequest.title: SaveBidRequest

SaveBusinessHoursCalendarRequest.description:
Business hours of the tenant: a weekly schedule of windows per day ("mon" => [["08:00", "12:00"], ["13:00", "17:00"]])
in a time zone, holidays as dates (Y-m-d, or m-d every year), and optionally an HR holiday calendar to reuse.
SaveBusinessHoursCalendarRequest.title: SaveBusinessHoursCalendarRequest

SaveConstructionSiteRequest.description: A construction site (cantiere) referenced by progress billings (SAL) and by bids.
SaveConstructionSiteRequest.title: SaveConstructionSiteRequest

SaveContractObligationRequest.description: Validates an obligation or milestone of a contract (access is decided by module.access).
SaveContractObligationRequest.title: SaveContractObligationRequest

SaveContractPartyRequest.description:
Validates a party linked to a contract. A linked party must belong to the active company (a user must be a member of
it); an external party is just a name (access is decided by module.access).
SaveContractPartyRequest.title: SaveContractPartyRequest

SaveCustomerVehicleRequest.description: A customer vehicle (the "vehicles" register used by workshop folders, recurring services and the tire hotel).
SaveCustomerVehicleRequest.title: SaveCustomerVehicleRequest

SaveDeclarationRequest.description: Field types and sizes come from the e-dec schema v4.0.
SaveDeclarationRequest.title: SaveDeclarationRequest

SaveDepartmentRequest.description: A department of the org chart; every reference must belong to the active company.
SaveDepartmentRequest.title: SaveDepartmentRequest

SaveEscalationRuleRequest.description:
An escalation rule: when a pending approval step is reminded, to whom and when it escalates, and what the engine
decides by itself when the time limit runs out (access is decided by module.access:workflow_design).
SaveEscalationRuleRequest.title: SaveEscalationRuleRequest

SaveFolderRequest.description: Validates a workshop folder: vehicle, kind, currency and reception data.
SaveFolderRequest.title: SaveFolderRequest

SaveLeadScoringRuleRequest.description:
Creation or update of a lead scoring rule. Field rules need a whitelisted field and operator; activity rules need
an activity type or status to count. On update every field is optional.
SaveLeadScoringRuleRequest.title: SaveLeadScoringRuleRequest

SaveLeaveAccrualPolicyRequest.description:
An accrual policy of a leave type. source_reference records where the entitlement comes from (contract clause,
collective agreement article, law): the application does not supply statutory values.
SaveLeaveAccrualPolicyRequest.title: SaveLeaveAccrualPolicyRequest

SaveLeaveTypeRequest.description:
An absence (leave) type of the company. The yearly entitlement is company data (contract, collective agreement or
law as the company applies it); nothing is assumed.
SaveLeaveTypeRequest.title: SaveLeaveTypeRequest

SaveOvertimeRuleRequest.description:
An overtime rule of the company. Threshold and premium come from the law or the collective agreement the company
applies; source_reference records which one.
SaveOvertimeRuleRequest.title: SaveOvertimeRuleRequest

SavePipelineStageRequest.description:
Creation or update of a pipeline stage. The code is unique per tenant and immutable after creation, because
integrations and the stage-change endpoint address stages by code.
SavePipelineStageRequest.title: SavePipelineStageRequest

SavePositionRequest.description: A position of the org chart; every reference must belong to the active company.
SavePositionRequest.title: SavePositionRequest

SavePriceItemRequest.description: Validates an item of a price list; position codes are unique within the list.
SavePriceItemRequest.title: SavePriceItemRequest

SavePriceListRequest.description: Validates a price list of the company.
SavePriceListRequest.title: SavePriceListRequest

SaveReportDefinitionRequest.description: Validates a saved report definition (access is decided by module.access and the policy of the definition).
SaveReportDefinitionRequest.title: SaveReportDefinitionRequest

SaveSalaryComponentRequest.description: A salary component of the active contract: the payroll wage type code it is paid with and the amount.
SaveSalaryComponentRequest.title: SaveSalaryComponentRequest

SaveSegmentRequest.description:
Creation or update of a marketing segment. The filter definition is checked against the whitelist of
SegmentService when saved, so a broken segment is refused here rather than failing when a campaign is built.
SaveSegmentRequest.title: SaveSegmentRequest

SaveStockUnitRequest.description: Validates a vehicle of the dealer stock; stock numbers are unique within the company.
SaveStockUnitRequest.title: SaveStockUnitRequest

SaveSupportMailboxRequest.description: Creates or changes a support mailbox. On a change every field is optional and a missing password keeps the stored one.
SaveSupportMailboxRequest.title: SaveSupportMailboxRequest

SaveTemplateRequest.description:
Validates a message template: a code, a channel and a language that are unique together, a single-line subject, and a
body whose braces are all well-formed placeholders (access is decided by module.access).
SaveTemplateRequest.title: SaveTemplateRequest

SaveWorkCycleRequest.description: Validates a work cycle and its steps.
SaveWorkCycleRequest.title: SaveWorkCycleRequest

SaveWorkflowDefinitionRequest.description:
A workflow definition. On creation the graph can be sent inline: nodes by node_key, transitions between node keys.
The code is fixed once created; a new version of a code is a new definition with the same code.
SaveWorkflowDefinitionRequest.title: SaveWorkflowDefinitionRequest

SaveWorkflowTransitionRequest.description: A transition between two nodes of the definition in the route.
SaveWorkflowTransitionRequest.title: SaveWorkflowTransitionRequest

SdiChannel.description: The ways a tenant can talk to the Italian Exchange System (SDI).
SdiChannel.title: SdiChannel

SellVehicleRequest.description: Validates the sale of a stock vehicle: buyer of the company, date, price and VAT rate.
SellVehicleRequest.title: SellVehicleRequest

SendDocumentRequest.description: Validates the sending of an invoice or a quote on a channel (access is decided by module.access).
SendDocumentRequest.title: SendDocumentRequest

SendEDocumentRequest.description: Validates the input of the send edocument operation (authorization is decided by module.access).
SendEDocumentRequest.title: SendEDocumentRequest

SendMessageRequest.description: Validates the sending of a message built from a template of the company (access is decided by module.access).
SendMessageRequest.title: SendMessageRequest

SendSubcontractRequest.description: Validation of components sent to a subcontractor for a subcontracted operation.
SendSubcontractRequest.title: SendSubcontractRequest

SetWorkCenterCalendarRequest.description: Validation of the weekly calendar of a work centre: gross hours per ISO weekday (1 = Monday), each weekday once.
SetWorkCenterCalendarRequest.title: SetWorkCenterCalendarRequest

ShiftCategory.description: What a shift type stands for in the plan.
ShiftCategory.title: ShiftCategory

ShiftPeriodRequest.description: A period of the plan: at most a year, so that one call cannot walk the calendar without end.
ShiftPeriodRequest.title: ShiftPeriodRequest

ShiftSequencePattern.description: How a sequence turns its steps into days. A rotation runs through its steps from the start of the assignment; a weekly pattern takes one step per weekday (Monday first) and leaves the excluded days free; a manual sequence generates nothing.
ShiftSequencePattern.title: ShiftSequencePattern

ShiftVolunteerRequest.description: A volunteer for a shift: its availability, an assignment or a substitution.
ShiftVolunteerRequest.title: ShiftVolunteerRequest

StartExecutionRequest.description:
Validation of a job card started on an operation: the operator is a member of the company, the machine one of its
machine centres.
StartExecutionRequest.title: StartExecutionRequest

StartWorkOrderRequest.description: Validation of the start of a work order.
StartWorkOrderRequest.title: StartWorkOrderRequest

StoreAccountRequest.description:
Creation of a CRM account. The account references a contact (the party master): either an existing one through
`contact_id`, or one matched or created from the master data fields sent alongside the CRM attributes.
StoreAccountRequest.title: StoreAccountRequest

StoreAccrualRequest.description: An accrual or deferral (rateo o risconto): type, amount of the whole coverage, coverage dates, cut-off and accounts.
StoreAccrualRequest.title: StoreAccrualRequest

StoreActivityRequest.description:
Logging of a CRM activity on a lead, account, contact, opportunity or campaign. The related record and the assignee
must belong to the active tenant, so an activity can never be attached to another tenant's data.
StoreActivityRequest.title: StoreActivityRequest

StoreAssetCategoryRequest.description: Validation of an asset category, its depreciation presets, fiscal parameters (configured by the tenant, none shipped) and ledger accounts.
StoreAssetCategoryRequest.title: StoreAssetCategoryRequest

StoreAssetClassRequest.description: Validation of an operational asset class.
StoreAssetClassRequest.title: StoreAssetClassRequest

StoreBankAccountRequest.description:
A bank account of the active tenant. The IBAN is checked (ISO 13616) and unique in the tenant; the ledger account,
when given, must be an account of the tenant chart. On update (PUT/PATCH) every field is optional and the IBAN and
currency cannot change, because movements were already booked on them.
StoreBankAccountRequest.title: StoreBankAccountRequest

StoreBankChargeRequest.description: A bank fee, or interest earned or charged, on a bank account.
StoreBankChargeRequest.title: StoreBankChargeRequest

StoreBillingPlanRequest.description: A billing plan of a sales order of the active company: each item a percentage of the order net or an amount.
StoreBillingPlanRequest.title: StoreBillingPlanRequest

StoreCalendarExceptionRequest.description: Validation of a dated capacity exception of a work centre (0 hours for a closure).
StoreCalendarExceptionRequest.title: StoreCalendarExceptionRequest

StoreCallOffRequest.description: A call-off order on a framework agreement.
StoreCallOffRequest.title: StoreCallOffRequest

StoreCampaignMemberRequest.description: Adds one contact or one lead of the active tenant, or a whole segment, to a campaign.
StoreCampaignMemberRequest.title: StoreCampaignMemberRequest

StoreCampaignRequest.description: References to other records are validated against the active tenant (TenantScopedRules).
StoreCampaignRequest.title: StoreCampaignRequest

StoreCashMovementRequest.description: A receipt or payment of a cash register, in cash or by cheque, against a counter account of the chart.
StoreCashMovementRequest.title: StoreCashMovementRequest

StoreCashRegisterRequest.description: A cash register on a ledger account of the tenant chart.
StoreCashRegisterRequest.title: StoreCashRegisterRequest

StoreChangeOrderRequest.description: A change order with its cost, revenue and schedule impact; with lines, the cost impact must equal their sum.
StoreChangeOrderRequest.title: StoreChangeOrderRequest

StoreConsentRequest.description:
A GDPR consent event (grant or withdrawal) for one contact or one lead of the active tenant, with its source and
capture time as evidence.
StoreConsentRequest.title: StoreConsentRequest

StoreContractLineRequest.description: An item of a framework agreement with its agreed price and validity.
StoreContractLineRequest.title: StoreContractLineRequest

StoreContractRequest.description: Validates the input of the store contract operation (authorization is decided by module.access).
StoreContractRequest.title: StoreContractRequest

StoreDimensionRequest.description: A cost centre or profit centre: code unique in the tenant, name and active flag. On update every field is optional.
StoreDimensionRequest.title: StoreDimensionRequest

StoreDiscountPolicyRequest.description:
A discount policy or promotion: header discount, validity, limits, priority, stacking and its rules (by product,
customer or customer group). On update omitted fields keep their value; `rules`, when given, replace the rules.
StoreDiscountPolicyRequest.title: StoreDiscountPolicyRequest

StoreDocumentRequest.description: Validates the input of the store document operation (authorization is decided by module.access).
StoreDocumentRequest.title: StoreDocumentRequest

StoreDocumentVersionRequest.description: Validates the input of the store document version operation (authorization is decided by module.access).
StoreDocumentVersionRequest.title: StoreDocumentVersionRequest

shop_domain.description: A bare host: the Shopify address of the shop, or another domain of the shop resolving to public addresses.

StoreEmployeeDocumentRequest.description: An upload to the personnel file (PDF, image or office document, at most 20 MB) with its retention date.
StoreEmployeeDocumentRequest.title: StoreEmployeeDocumentRequest

StoreEmploymentContractRequest.description:
A new contract of an employee. The collective agreement and its level are references to the payroll agreement tables
of the company (or generic rows); amounts are decimal strings or numbers with at most two decimals.
StoreEmploymentContractRequest.title: StoreEmploymentContractRequest

StoreFileRequest.description: A single document uploaded to the private disk: meeting attachments, receipts of expenses, contracts.
StoreFileRequest.title: StoreFileRequest

StoreFixedAssetRequest.description: Validation of a new fixed asset.
StoreFixedAssetRequest.title: StoreFixedAssetRequest

StoreFolderLineRequest.description: Validates a labour, part or other line of a workshop folder.
StoreFolderLineRequest.title: StoreFolderLineRequest

StoreFolderRequest.description: Validates the input of the store folder operation (authorization is decided by module.access).
StoreFolderRequest.title: StoreFolderRequest

StoreForecastRequest.description: Validation of a demand forecast entry.
StoreForecastRequest.title: StoreForecastRequest

StoreForecastScenarioRequest.description: A liquidity forecast scenario: delays and growth factor applied to the expected flows.
StoreForecastScenarioRequest.title: StoreForecastScenarioRequest

StoreFxRevaluationRequest.description: Date and optional currency of a revaluation of open receivables and payables.
StoreFxRevaluationRequest.title: StoreFxRevaluationRequest

StoreHealthExpenseRequest.description: Validates the flagging of a document as a health expense.
StoreHealthExpenseRequest.title: StoreHealthExpenseRequest

StoreItemRequest.description: Validation of a new manufacturing item.
StoreItemRequest.title: StoreItemRequest

StoreLandedCostRequest.description: A landed cost to allocate on goods receipts.
StoreLandedCostRequest.title: StoreLandedCostRequest

StoreLeadRequest.description: References to other records are validated against the active tenant (TenantScopedRules).
StoreLeadRequest.title: StoreLeadRequest

StoreMaintenancePlanRequest.description: Validation of a preventive maintenance plan (time, meter or both).
StoreMaintenancePlanRequest.title: StoreMaintenancePlanRequest

StoreMaintenanceWorkOrderRequest.description: Validation of a new maintenance work order.
StoreMaintenanceWorkOrderRequest.title: StoreMaintenanceWorkOrderRequest

StoreMilestoneRequest.description: A milestone; with a billing amount (or a percentage of the contract value) it becomes billable once completed.
StoreMilestoneRequest.title: StoreMilestoneRequest

StoreNonConformanceRequest.description: Validation of a non-conformance raised by hand.
StoreNonConformanceRequest.title: StoreNonConformanceRequest

StoreOpportunityRequest.description: References to other records are validated against the active tenant (TenantScopedRules).
StoreOpportunityRequest.title: StoreOpportunityRequest

StorePaymentProposalRequest.description: The selection criteria of a supplier payment proposal.
StorePaymentProposalRequest.title: StorePaymentProposalRequest

StorePeriodCloseTaskRequest.description: A task of the close checklist of a period.
StorePeriodCloseTaskRequest.title: StorePeriodCloseTaskRequest

StorePositionRequest.description: A position from a price list item, a work cycle, or entered by hand.
StorePositionRequest.title: StorePositionRequest

StoreProcurementApprovalMatrixRequest.description: An approval matrix of purchase orders or requisitions: levels by amount, optionally for one cost centre.
StoreProcurementApprovalMatrixRequest.title: StoreProcurementApprovalMatrixRequest

StoreProductRequest.description:
Creation of a product. `min_stock` is the reorder threshold watched by the low stock dashboard widget; null means
the product is not monitored.
StoreProductRequest.title: StoreProductRequest

StoreProjectBudgetRequest.description: A budget revision by cost category; the total cost budget is computed as the sum of the categories.
StoreProjectBudgetRequest.title: StoreProjectBudgetRequest

StoreProjectCostEntryRequest.description: A manual cost entry referencing its source document; a source document is booked once per project.
StoreProjectCostEntryRequest.title: StoreProjectCostEntryRequest

StoreProjectExpenseRequest.description: An out-of-pocket project expense, recorded as pending until approved.
StoreProjectExpenseRequest.title: StoreProjectExpenseRequest

StoreProjectRequest.description: Opening a project: customer, dates, project manager, contract value and how its revenue is recognised.
StoreProjectRequest.title: StoreProjectRequest

StorePurchaseOrderRequest.description:
A new purchase order. The number comes from the gapless series of the company; a line without a price takes the
agreed price of its framework agreement line or the valid supplier price list price.
StorePurchaseOrderRequest.title: StorePurchaseOrderRequest

StoreQualityPlanRequest.description: Validation of an inspection plan with its characteristics.
StoreQualityPlanRequest.title: StoreQualityPlanRequest

StoreRateCardRequest.description: An hourly cost and billing rate for a person or a role, optionally limited to a project and a validity period.
StoreRateCardRequest.title: StoreRateCardRequest

StoreReconciliationRuleRequest.description:
A reconciliation rule. At least one condition is required, an incoming rule can only produce internal transfers and
the account, when given, must be in the chart of accounts of the tenant. On update every field is optional.
StoreReconciliationRuleRequest.title: StoreReconciliationRuleRequest

StoreRecurringCashItemRequest.description: A recurring cash flow projected by the liquidity forecast.
StoreRecurringCashItemRequest.title: StoreRecurringCashItemRequest

StoreRecurringJournalRequest.description: A recurring journal template: frequency, first due date, optional end and balanced lines.
StoreRecurringJournalRequest.title: StoreRecurringJournalRequest

StoreRecurringServiceRequest.description: Validates a recurring service (for example yearly tyre storage) billed through a subscription.
StoreRecurringServiceRequest.title: StoreRecurringServiceRequest

StoreRetentionPolicyRequest.description: Validates the input of the store retention policy operation (authorization is decided by module.access).
StoreRetentionPolicyRequest.title: StoreRetentionPolicyRequest

StoreRevenueRecognitionRequest.description:
A revenue recognition run for an accounting date; the completion percentage may be stated only under the
percentage-of-completion method.
StoreRevenueRecognitionRequest.title: StoreRevenueRecognitionRequest

StoreRfqRequest.description: A request for quotation to several suppliers, from an approved requisition or a list of items.
StoreRfqRequest.title: StoreRfqRequest

StoreSalesReturnRequest.description:
A return request: the delivery note or invoice the goods came with, the reason, and the lines returned (each naming
the line of the source document).
StoreSalesReturnRequest.title: StoreSalesReturnRequest

StoreSupplierCatalogRequest.description: A supplier catalogue entry; with `id` in the route it is an update and every field is optional.
StoreSupplierCatalogRequest.title: StoreSupplierCatalogRequest

StoreSupplierDocumentRequest.description: A qualification document of a supplier.
StoreSupplierDocumentRequest.title: StoreSupplierDocumentRequest

StoreSupplierPriceRequest.description: A price (quantity break) of a catalogue entry with its validity.
StoreSupplierPriceRequest.title: StoreSupplierPriceRequest

StoreSupplierQuoteRequest.description: The quote of an invited supplier on a request for quotation.
StoreSupplierQuoteRequest.title: StoreSupplierQuoteRequest

StoreTagRequest.description: Validates the input of the store tag operation (authorization is decided by module.access).
StoreTagRequest.title: StoreTagRequest

StoreTaskAssignmentRequest.description: A member of the company assigned to the task, with the hours planned for them on it.
StoreTaskAssignmentRequest.title: StoreTaskAssignmentRequest

StoreTaskDependencyRequest.description: A predecessor of the task in the path, with the type of link and the lag in calendar days (negative for a lead).
StoreTaskDependencyRequest.title: StoreTaskDependencyRequest

StoreTaskRequest.description: A work package of the WBS. Phase, milestone and parent must belong to the same project (checked by the service).
StoreTaskRequest.title: StoreTaskRequest

StoreTimesheetRequest.description:
Hours on a project. Without user_id they are the hours of the caller; logging for someone else and stating rates
explicitly are reserved to the managers of the project (checked by the controller).
StoreTimesheetRequest.title: StoreTimesheetRequest

StoreTransferRequest.description: An internal transfer between two bank accounts of the tenant, in the same currency.
StoreTransferRequest.title: StoreTransferRequest

StoreWorkCenterRequest.description: Validation of a new work centre or of changes to one (PUT: every field optional, the code unique in the company).
StoreWorkCenterRequest.title: StoreWorkCenterRequest

SubmitDeclarationRequest.description: Records that a validated list was sent, with the protocol the receiving channel assigned to it.
SubmitDeclarationRequest.title: SubmitDeclarationRequest

SubmitEnrolmentRequest.description:
The public enrolment form. The rules follow the configuration of the form, found by the token of the link. The field
"website" is a trap for bots: people never see it.
SubmitEnrolmentRequest.title: SubmitEnrolmentRequest

SubmitOwnLeaveRequest.description: A leave request an employee submits for themselves: the employee is the one linked to the user.
SubmitOwnLeaveRequest.title: SubmitOwnLeaveRequest

TerminalScanRequest.description: One scan of any terminal operation. Which optional code is needed depends on the operation, named by the route.
TerminalScanRequest.title: TerminalScanRequest

TimeRecordSource.description: The instrument a time record comes from: the law leaves the employer free to choose it.
TimeRecordSource.title: TimeRecordSource

TimeRecordingMode.description:
The working time recording modes allowed by the Swiss ordinance 1 on the Labour Act (OLL 1). | | |---| | `Detailed`
Full recording (art. 73 OLL 1): start and end of work, breaks of 30 minutes or more, daily and weekly duration. | | `Simplified`
Simplified recording (art. 73b OLL 1): only the daily duration, plus start and end of night and Sunday work. | | `Waived`
Waiver (art. 73a OLL 1): collective agreement, great autonomy, salary above the threshold, individual written agreement. |
TimeRecordingMode.title: TimeRecordingMode

TipoCassa.description: TipoCassaType of the FatturaPA schema v1.2.3.
TipoCassa.title: TipoCassa

TipoDocumento.description: TipoDocumentoType of the FatturaPA schema v1.2.3. The descriptions are the ones of the XSD. The party and ledger rules are not in the schema: the report of the change lists the ones an accountant still has to confirm.
TipoDocumento.title: TipoDocumento

TipoRitenuta.description: TipoRitenutaType of the FatturaPA schema v1.2.3.
TipoRitenuta.title: TipoRitenuta

TransferAssetRequest.description: Validation of an asset transfer; at least one destination is required.
TransferAssetRequest.title: TransferAssetRequest

TransferOrderRequest.description:
A new transfer order (source and destination warehouses, lines) or a receipt of one (lines received, optional
destination bins; without lines everything in transit is received).
TransferOrderRequest.title: TransferOrderRequest

TransitionContractRequest.description:
Validates a lifecycle move of a contract. Terminating needs a reason (access is decided by module.access and the
contracts.terminate gate).
TransitionContractRequest.title: TransitionContractRequest

UpdateAccountRequest.description:
Update of a CRM account. CRM attributes stay on the account; master data fields (name, VAT number, email...) are
written to the linked contact so that sales documents see the same values. `contact_id` relinks the account, which
is how an ambiguous backfill decision is resolved.
UpdateAccountRequest.title: UpdateAccountRequest

UpdateAccountingSettingsRequest.description: Validation of the ledger account codes of manufacturing (null goes back to the module default).
UpdateAccountingSettingsRequest.title: UpdateAccountingSettingsRequest

UpdateActivityRequest.description:
Reschedule, reassign or cancel an open activity. Completion has its own endpoint because it records an outcome and
raises a domain event.
UpdateActivityRequest.title: UpdateActivityRequest

UpdateAiSettingRequest.description: Validates the input of the update ai setting operation (authorization is decided by module.access).
UpdateAiSettingRequest.title: UpdateAiSettingRequest

UpdateChannelRequest.description:
Validates the configuration of a channel. The SMTP server of a company must be a public host (never the local machine,
a private network or cloud metadata), and a driver accepts only its own credential keys (access is decided by
module.access).
UpdateChannelRequest.title: UpdateChannelRequest

UpdateContractTermsRequest.description: Validates the input of the update contract terms operation (authorization is decided by module.access).
UpdateContractTermsRequest.title: UpdateContractTermsRequest

UpdateCreditLimitRequest.description: Credit limit of a customer of the active company; 0 means that no limit is set (exposure is not checked).
UpdateCreditLimitRequest.title: UpdateCreditLimitRequest

UpdateDashboardLayoutRequest.description:
Replaces the dashboard of the current user: which widgets, where they sit on the 12 column grid and how each one is
configured.
UpdateDashboardLayoutRequest.title: UpdateDashboardLayoutRequest

UpdateDocumentRequest.description: Validates the input of the update document operation (authorization is decided by module.access).
UpdateDocumentRequest.title: UpdateDocumentRequest

UpdateEmploymentContractRequest.description: The descriptive data of the active contract; pay, hours and start change through a new contract.
UpdateEmploymentContractRequest.title: UpdateEmploymentContractRequest

UpdateFixedAssetRequest.description: Validation of the descriptive, warranty and insurance data of an asset; values change only through the lifecycle operations.
UpdateFixedAssetRequest.title: UpdateFixedAssetRequest

UpdateInvoiceRequest.description:
What can still change on a sales document after its creation: the notes, and the due date of a document not yet
issued (a proforma or a draft). The due date of an issued document is part of its ledger entry and payment schedule,
so the controller refuses it.
UpdateInvoiceRequest.title: UpdateInvoiceRequest

UpdateItemRequest.description: Validation of changes to a manufacturing item (code and standard cost breakdown cannot be changed here).
UpdateItemRequest.title: UpdateItemRequest

UpdateLedgerSettingsRequest.description: Default posting accounts by role and four-eyes policy of manual journals. Only the keys sent are changed.
UpdateLedgerSettingsRequest.title: UpdateLedgerSettingsRequest

UpdatePeriodCloseTaskStatusRequest.description: Marks a close task done, waived (with the reason in the note) or open again.
UpdatePeriodCloseTaskStatusRequest.title: UpdatePeriodCloseTaskStatusRequest

UpdatePlanRequest.description:
Changes of a plan that do not alter the price of the billed periods: names, availability, VAT rate of the next
invoices, trial, renewal increase and ledger accounts.
UpdatePlanRequest.title: UpdatePlanRequest

UpdateProcurementSettingsRequest.description: Tolerances of the company for receipts and invoice matching.
UpdateProcurementSettingsRequest.title: UpdateProcurementSettingsRequest

UpdateProductRequest.description: Update of a product: only the fields sent change. `min_stock` may be set to null to stop monitoring the product.
UpdateProductRequest.title: UpdateProductRequest

UpdateProductVariantRequest.description: Update of one variant. Attributes sent replace the option attributes (size, colour, ...) of the variant.
UpdateProductVariantRequest.title: UpdateProductVariantRequest

UpdateProjectRequest.description:
Changing the master data of a project. The status moves only through the lifecycle endpoints (start, pause, resume,
close), and the contract value only while the project is draft or planned: afterwards it moves through change orders.
UpdateProjectRequest.title: UpdateProjectRequest

UpdatePurchaseOrderRequest.description:
Changes to a draft (or rejected) purchase order; the supplier, the number and the agreement cannot change. Given
lines replace the current ones.
UpdatePurchaseOrderRequest.title: UpdatePurchaseOrderRequest

UpdateSupplierQualificationRequest.description: New qualification status of a supplier with the next review date.
UpdateSupplierQualificationRequest.title: UpdateSupplierQualificationRequest

UpdateTaskRequest.description: Changes to a task: plan dates, status, progress and actual dates. Completing a task sets its progress to 100%.
UpdateTaskRequest.title: UpdateTaskRequest

UpdateWarehouseBinRequest.description:
Changes to the master data of a bin: its type, capacities, lock and picking position. Location and barcode are
identity and do not change here.
